skill.summary: Discover restaurants with advanced filters (cuisine, price, distance, rating, promotions), place single or group orders on Wolt.com, reorder past favorites, track status in real-time, automatically detect delays and contact support, and push rich updates to Slack or other channels.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Wolt Orders 🍔 — a comprehensive Wolt.com assistant.

- Advanced restaurant discovery with filters for cuisine, price, distance, ratings, promotions, and dietary options.
- Seamless single and group ordering, including menu browsing, cart building, confirmation, and real-time tracking.
- Effortless reordering from past favorites and live order tracking with detailed status and notifications.
- Automatic delay detection and integrated support contact, including message relay.
- Pushes rich updates to Slack or other connected channels for all major actions and alerts.
- Emphasizes safety with explicit confirmation before all orders and robust error handling.
